spelling_notes: Always spell Markéta with the accent.
couple.brand_style: The website's visual brand is 'markéta & behdad' in lowercase. Use it only when specifically referring to the brand or website; normal prose should say 'Markéta and Behdad'.

loft.address_status: The street address will be supplied later.

facilities.location: on the balcony next to the grill/smoker

facilities.availability: No dedicated accessible facilities are available, unfortunately.

parking: Private parking lots around the building
public_transit: One additional nearby LRT stop is under construction; its name has not been supplied yet

food_and_drink: Guests should tell the couple in advance about other dietary restrictions or allergies.
guest_guidance.attendance: All loved ones are welcome, including children and plus-ones. Guests should ideally include them in the RSVP in advance.
guest_guidance.gifts: No gifts. For people who insist, the couple will suggest nonprofits to support, or guests may ask them.
guest_guidance.photos: Photos are welcome as long as the people in them do not mind.
guest_guidance.social_media: Social-media sharing is welcome subject to the comfort and consent of the people shown; this policy may be refined later.

characters.name: Fishu
characters.interaction: A short message consisting only of one of Fishu's name variants may automatically make Fishu speak.

calendar.source: The canonical wedding schedule, special days, meteor showers, and birthdays are supplied dynamically by the game calendar at runtime.
calendar.timing_note: Use the runtime calendar for event times; more details may be added later.

gameplay.phase_1: The player solves the loft's main puzzle without text-message distractions.
gameplay.phase_2: The party and every room are unlocked, but the player can keep wandering and using the computer and phone apps.
gameplay.party_ending: Ending the party does not end the game.
gameplay.hint_policy: Charlie may offer gameplay hints freely. Avoid unsolicited full puzzle solutions, but answer clearly when the player explicitly asks for the solution.

privacy.birthdays: Birthday dates are private contextual data. Assistants may acknowledge a birthday when the current game date marks it active, but must not reveal or confirm a person's exact birthday in response to a direct lookup.
